game.title: Borderlands 2
game.blurb: Co-op looter shooter and role-playing game from Gearbox Software (RAWG also lists Aspyr Media, 2K and Sony Computer Entertainment America), published by 2K Games and Aspyr, released 2012-09-18. RAWG average playtime: 11 hours. Genres: Action, Shooter, RPG. Chapters are an estimate drawn from Steam achievement themes, with a chapter per DLC the achievements name.

chapters.title: The Main Story, Part 1
chapters.summary: The first eight story milestones, all hidden on Steam. Spoiler-guarded.

chapters.title: The Main Story, Part 2
chapters.summary: The later story milestones and a few other hidden achievements. Spoiler-guarded.

chapters.title: Levels, Challenges and Gear
chapters.summary: Reaching levels 5 to 50, the challenges, the Circle of Slaughter, tokens, customization items, the black market, Purple-rated gear and tipping Moxxi.

chapters.title: Exploration and Side Missions
chapters.summary: Discovering every named location, region by region, and finishing 20 and then all side missions.

chapters.title: Combat and Skills
chapters.summary: The Sabre turret, Phaselock, Gunzerking, Decepti0n, Goliaths, Constructors, rare enemies, revives and high-fiving Claptrap.

chapters.title: DLC: Captain Scarlett and Her Pirate's Booty
chapters.summary: Oasis and the Pirate's Booty zones, their side missions and the mission X Marks the Spot.

chapters.title: DLC: Campaign of Carnage and Hammerlock's Hunt
chapters.summary: Campaign of Carnage (Long Way To The Top, its side missions and Moxxi's pictures) and Hammerlock's Hunt (The Fall of Nakayama, its side missions and locations).

chapters.title: DLC: Tiny Tina's Assault on Dragon Keep
chapters.summary: The White Knight, the queen, Mister Boney Pants Guy, Immortal Skeletaurs, Murderlin's Temple, the Mysterious Amulet and the Ancient Dragons of Destruction.

chapters.title: DLC: The Backburner to Paradise Found
chapters.summary: The Backburner's firewall, the moonshot cannon, Haderax the Invincible, the Dark Web and the mission Paradise Found, plus one hidden achievement.

notes: Backlog game, all-AAA pass: picked from RAWG's most-added list for its year across all genres (docs/PLAN.md section 2, genre filter widened 2026-10-23). RAWG's first result is the expected entry (id 802). Steam app 49520 ("Borderlands 2" in the store list; its schema is named "Borderlands") was used; the store list also has "Borderlands 2 VR" (991260), not used. RAWG lists 13 additions, including Captain Scarlett and Her Pirate's Booty, Mr. Torgue's Campaign of Carnage, Sir Hammerlock's Big Game Hunt, Tiny Tina's Assault on Dragon Keep, five Headhunter packs and Commander Lilith & the Fight for Sanctuary. Pirate's Booty, Campaign of Carnage and Hammerlock's Hunt are named in achievement descriptions. Achievement_60 to 69 do not name their DLC; they were matched to Tiny Tina's Assault on Dragon Keep from their wording (the White Knight, the queen, Murderlin's Temple, dragons), a reasoned guess. Achievement_70 to 75 do not name a DLC either; they may be Commander Lilith & the Fight for Sanctuary, but that is not confirmed by the data, so the chapter is named after what the achievements mention. No achievement names a Headhunter pack. Each DLC block is three achievements apart from Dragon Keep (ten) and the last block (six); "Treasure Hunter" (X Marks the Spot), "Explosive" (Long Way To The Top) and "Face Off" (The Fall of Nakayama) were placed by their position before each block's named achievements. Campaign of Carnage and Hammerlock's Hunt share one chapter to keep within nine chapters. StrategyWiki has "Borderlands 2" at completion stage 0: only Challenges (about 17,100 characters), Controls (about 4,700) and Table of Contents are written; Gameplay and Walkthrough are linked but not written. borderlands.fandom.com answers the API under "Borderlands 2" with about 151 linked articles; names only were looked at, nothing copied. 21 of 75 Steam achievements are hidden. Achievement_1 to 16 fall steadily from 89.5% to 30.2% and look like story milestones; they are split eight and eight by API number, our own choice. The other hidden ones, "What does it mean?", "Well, That Was Easy", "Thresher Thrashed" and "Feels Like The First Time", sit among base-game achievements and were put in Part 2 as a placeholder; "Painbow Connection" (1.2%) sits in the last block, so it is in that DLC chapter.
